t: A high-power Meshtastic base station board for rooftop and vehicle repeaters.
steps: Look for a used or leftover Station G2. The maker's Tindie shop is sold out, and the newer Station G3 replaces it.
Get a USB-C PD charger that supplies 15 V at 20 W or more.
Attach the antenna before power on. Use a short cable to protect the SMA socket.
Power the board and install the Meshtastic app on your phone.
Pair over Bluetooth and set your region to match local rules.
Keep output at the default 30 dBm unless you hold a ham license.
Update firmware with the Meshtastic web flasher using the station-g2 build.
